2 General interpretation.

(1) References to the accused are to the person mentioned in section 1(1) or (2).

(2) Where there is more than one accused in any proceedings this Part applies separately
in relation to each of the accused.

4 Criminal Procedure and Investigations Act 1996 (c. 25)
